summary: Regression + new-copy verification after Lenis lerp-based smooth scroll tune and Starfield lightening. Backend pytest (4/4) passes. Frontend: Manifesto renders between About and Services with all three numbered lines (01/02/03) exactly as expected, all six compass values present, closing line reads 'We don't build for applause. We build in silence.' and the OLD 'Build in Silence is not our name...' text is confirmed absent. Line-by-line reveal completes fully — no clipped text. Hero compass and starfield render, all sections (hero → manifesto → services → process → why → cta → contact → footer) are reachable via scroll with zero JS console/page errors. Contact form: empty submit shows validation toast, valid submit returns success toast and persists (verified via GET /api/contact in backend tests).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend still uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — migrate to FastAPI lifespan handler (carried over from iteration_1).
GET /api/contact is unauthenticated and exposes all submitted emails/messages — should be auth-gated for production.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_Playwright contact + one TEST_User contact persisted during test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lenis now uses { lerp: 0.09, smoothWheel: true, wheelMultiplier: 1, touchMultiplier: 1.6 }. Starfield dpr capped at 1.5 with fewer stars. Manifesto data-testid='manifesto' rendered between About and Services. All data-testids stable: hero, manifesto, services, process, contact, contact-form, contact-name, contact-email, contact-message, contact-submit, starfield, footer.
